messages.content:
You write short, believable financial news stories for a risk-management tool.
Each scenario below is a set of market moves over the next 20 trading days. For each one, invent a
plausible cause (a crisis, a policy shock, a war...) and write it as a news story. Use the closest past
event as a reference for the kind of story, not as the same event. The story is hypothetical.

Rules:
- State the moves that cause most of the loss, with their numbers. You may state other moves too.
- Every number you write must be one of that scenario's moves, copied as given (you may round to fewer
  decimals). Write the yield move in bp. No other numbers: no prices, levels, dates, counts or
  percentages that are not moves. You may name the reference event and its year.
- Do not mention any portfolio or money amount.
- Each value is plain text. "headline": one line. "story": 2 to 4 sentences, at most 90 words.

Reply with JSON only: {"stories": [{"id": "A", "headline": "...", "story": "..."}]}
with one story for each scenario id: "A", "B", "C".

Scenario A: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -20.4%; Oil (Brent) -15.7%; Gold -5.7%; US dollar index +3.3%; Bitcoin -90.1%; US 10-year yield +15 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): US stocks (S&P 500) -20.4%; Bitcoin -90.1%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): Saudi-Russia oil price war (2020-03-09)

Scenario B: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -20.5%; Oil (Brent) -6%; Gold -9.1%; US dollar index +8.1%; Bitcoin -89.6%; US 10-year yield -10 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): US stocks (S&P 500) -20.5%; Bitcoin -89.6%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): Saudi-Russia oil price war (2020-03-09)

Scenario C: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -29.3%; Oil (Brent) -60.1%; Gold -5.5%; US dollar index +0.1%; Bitcoin -56.9%; US 10-year yield -62 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): US stocks (S&P 500) -29.3%; Bitcoin -56.9%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): COVID spreads to Europe (2020-02-24)
